repair: The versioned prompt explicitly scopes per-slide speech and slide facts to the matching registry slide. Strict evidence validation, provider model, rubric and UI were unchanged; exact prior protocols permit a fresh generation only.

harness_correction.initial_assumption: Expected completed rather than the API stale projection after the version upgrade.

usage.measurement: Observed shared-key metadata at completion; includes possible concurrent use and may lag provider accounting. Scribe charges are excluded. This is not an exact combined-provider invoice.

limitations: This controlled case establishes API execution and accepted evidence structure, not calibrated scores or broad semantic-quality accuracy.
